purpose: Editable planning targets; not runtime configuration or achieved test results

quality_targets.reference_hardware: To be recorded in OW-00; performance claims require hardware qualification

gates.title: Qualify the baseline
acceptance: Record reference PC hardware and settings
Reproduce packaged build and retained rollback
Capture traversal/frame-time baseline
Separate synthetic input from physical controller evidence

gates.title: Believable playable crew
acceptance: Review reference likeness for Marty, Lakitu and Rio
Finish cat articulation and required movement/rest clips
Preserve Marty ear secondary motion
Pass existing gameplay and control regressions

gates.title: Connected home-yard-park slice
acceptance: Three favours and six discoveries
Two route loops and reliable recovery
Complete solo/controller walkthrough
Persist slice completion across reload

gates.title: Outdoor two-player slice
acceptance: All three two-pet pairings complete shared favour
Verify two separate PCs with role swap
Pass contested item ownership trials
Pass district travel and disconnect/rejoin
Preserve guest solo data

gates.title: Campaign neighbourhood
acceptance: Five districts, six campaign missions, 14 optional favours
At least five activity patterns
No mandatory unreachable or missing-third-player steps
Pass navigation, persistence and family play review

gates.title: Polish and distribute
acceptance: Meet hardware-qualified performance/scalability targets
Pass physical keyboard/Xbox/PlayStation walkthroughs
Pass captions/audio-off and comedy pacing review
Verify second-PC packaged launch and transfer privacy
Publish current actual test evidence

scope_rules: Solo and any two-pet pairing can complete the critical path
Host owns shared world/checkpoints; guest solo progress stays independent
Optional private local layout stays outside public assets and transfer archives
Character comedy roles are proposed fictional personalities
No planned gate is complete without actual acceptance evidence
